title: Roamhaven Rewards Status Validity and Annual Review Schedule
content:
A Roamhaven Rewards tier, once qualified, is held through 31 December of the year after the year in which it was qualified. Tiers are reviewed each year on 1 January.

| Tier | Tier held through | Annual review date | Most tiers dropped at one review | Nights rolled into the next qualification period | Most nights rolled over |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rewards Member | 31 December of the year after the qualifying year | 1 January | 1 | Not allowed | 0 |
| Rewards Silver | 31 December of the year after the qualifying year | 1 January | 1 | Not allowed | 0 |
| Rewards Gold | 31 December of the year after the qualifying year | 1 January | 1 | Not allowed | 0 |
| Rewards Platinum | 31 December of the year after the qualifying year | 1 January | 1 | Allowed | 20 |
| Rewards Diamond | 31 December of the year after the qualifying year | 1 January | 1 | Allowed | 30 |
| Rewards Ambassador | 31 December of the year after the qualifying year | 1 January | 1 | Allowed | 40 |

## Schedule notes

- **Validity.** The holding period runs to the last day of the calendar year that follows the qualifying year. On hypothetical dates: a tier qualified at any point in 2025 is held through 31 December 2026.
- **Review drop.** At an annual review a member's tier falls by no more than one level.
- **Rollover.** Rollover of nights is offered on Rewards Platinum, Rewards Diamond and Rewards Ambassador only, up to 20, 30 and 40 nights respectively. On Rewards Member, Rewards Silver and Rewards Gold no nights roll over; the maximum shown there is 0.

## Reading the drop limit (hypothetical members)

| Tier held before the review | Lowest tier the member can hold after the review |
|---|---|
| Rewards Ambassador | Rewards Diamond |
| Rewards Diamond | Rewards Platinum |
| Rewards Gold | Rewards Silver |
| Rewards Silver | Rewards Member |
